messages:
Alex Chen: Ok team — quick sync on long-term routing/tenant isolation. Product wants a clear path from today’s soft affinity -> stronger isolation for high-risk customers. Goals: predictable latency, cost bounds, and simpler ops runbook.
Morgan Lee: +1. Customer asks are mostly about data isolation + SLA. Also some want per-tenant quantization profiles to reduce cost.
Jamie Patel: Proposed approach: 'tenant-banding' — group tenants into bands based on SLA/cost sensitivity/region, route by band, and provide lane-specific fallbacks. Keeps flexible routing without full physical isolation for everyone.
Rachel Gomez: Sounds promising. Need to define launch criteria: latency p50/p99 by band, error-rate thresholds, and a migration plan for Dedicated customers.
Sam Ortiz: Ops flag: can we let teams opt into a band via API or does it require account-sales mapping? Prefer API + admin override.
Alex Chen: API opt-in is ideal for self-serve. Sales can request manual migration for enterprise. Also: define rollback policy if a band causes regression.
Jamie Patel: Sketch of routing policy (example):
```json
{
  "priority": ["band-A", "band-B", "band-C"],
  "band-A": {"regions": ["us-east-1"], "max_latency_ms": 120, "isolation": "dedicated"},
  "band-B": {"regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"], "max_latency_ms": 200, "isolation": "soft"}
}
```
Morgan Lee: Nice. We should add cost caps per band and automatic quantization profiles for band-B/C. Also signal flags for model fallback if p99 > threshold.
Rachel Gomez: Launch criteria proposal: 1) end-to-end perf stable in canary for 1 week, 2) no more than 2% increase in token cost for band-B, 3) automated rollback works within 5 minutes.
Sam Ortiz: For multi-region: we need affinity + regional fallback. If region A overloaded, route band-A to band-B-compatible variant in region B with cold-start controls. Document expected RTO/RPO.
Tina (oncall-bot): Note: add observability metrics: per-band p50/p95/p99, per-band token-cost, fallback-count, KV-cache-hit-rate, and active-tenant-count.
Alex Chen: Action items: Jamie to write short spec (1 pager) with policy JSON examples + migration plan; Morgan to capture product/customer asks and pricing constraints; Rachel to own launch criteria and runbook; Sam to map infra gaps & SLO implications. Aim to have draft by next Tues.
deploy-bot: @channel reminder: prev deploy to runtime staging at 202-03-01T14:00 UTC. Watch for perf regressions. :eyes:
Morgan Lee: Quick Q — do we consider encryption/tenant-keystore boundary as part of banding or separate private deployment?
Rachel Gomez: Keep keystore/private deployment separate. Banding is routing/ops surface; Private/Dedicated still needed for regulated customers. Call out explicitly in spec.
Alex Chen: Great — thanks everyone. I'll consolidate notes and ping for review. :thumbsup:
